sn55.35:1.1: cattārīmāni bhikkhave devānaṃ devapadāni avisuddhānaṃ sattānaṃ visuddhiyā apariyodātānaṃ sattānaṃ pariyodapanāya.
sn55.35:2.2: idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti
sn55.35:2.3: itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
sn55.35:2.8: na kho panāhaṃ kañci byābādhemi tasaṃ vā ṭhāvaraṃ vā
sn55.35:2.10: idaṃ paṭhamaṃ devānaṃ devapadaṃ avisuddhānaṃ sattānaṃ visuddhiyā apariyodātānaṃ sattānaṃ pariyodapanāya.
sn55.35:4.1: ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akkhaṇḍehi …pe… samādhi saṃvattanikehi.
sn55.35:4.3: kiṃ nu kho devānaṃ deva padanti.
sn55.35:4.6: na kho panāhaṃ kañci byābādhemi tasaṃ vā ṭhāvaraṃ vā
sn55.35:4.8: idaṃ catutthaṃ devānaṃ devapadaṃ avisuddhānaṃ sattānaṃ visuddhiyā apariyodātānaṃ sattānaṃ pariyodapanāya.
sn55.35:4.9: imāni kho bhikkhave cattāri devānaṃ devapadāni avisuddhānaṃ sattānaṃ visuddhiyā apariyodātānaṃ sattānaṃ pariyodapanāyāti.
